canonical_source.behavior: The source button formats AI WordPress Manager Error, Error ID, Correlation ID and copy-time, then awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText. It does not mutate server, tenant, WordPress or provider state.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The real Error surface renders only already-sanitized request/correlation IDs into an escaped application/json payload. Browser runtime adds copy-time at invocation and writes the source-equivalent report to Clipboard. Success is exposed only after writeText resolves; rejection/unavailable Clipboard produces a truthful retryable failure state; duplicate in-flight copies are suppressed.

security.authentication: anonymous by canonical Error route contract
security.proof: Feature coverage verifies malicious caller tracking headers are rejected by existing correlation middleware and do not enter the clipboard payload; exception/query secrets, stack traces and exception messages remain absent.

implementation.exact_head_policy: Terminal handoff is valid only when PR Plan Link, Laravel AIWMWeb Cross-Domain Security and Laravel AIWMWeb Acceptance all succeed on the final PR head. Exact run IDs are recorded in Issue #257 handoff rather than predeclared in this source artifact.
